images.why: Dedicated waterfall page confirms Colonial Creek Falls and its distant viewpoint. Useful identification reference; high-resolution suitability unverified.

images.author: Richard Droker
images.why: Explicitly credited photograph illustrating Colonial Creek Falls. Published derivative is limited to 768 pixels wide; seek the photographer's original for poster use.

images.author: David Moskowitz
images.why: Photographer identifies Colonial Creek Falls beside the approach to Colonial Glacier. Wider environmental view with a climber; 768×512 file is a low-resolution fallback. Only six attributable candidates were located.

images.author: Heather Jasper
images.why: Strong candidate showing Gocta's two drops in its green mountain setting. A 2500-pixel rendition is offered; native dimensions remain unverified.

images.author: Adriana Goyzueta
images.why: Photographer explicitly locates this forest waterfall at Gocta Cataracts, Peru. Camera metadata supports photographic provenance; 3000-pixel rendition requested.

images.author: Renzo Tasso / PROMPERÚ
images.why: Officially credited panoramic photograph of Gocta in Amazonas, with the waterfall and surrounding cloud-forest landscape. Landscape composition requires a careful 3:4 crop.

images.author: Heather Jasper
images.why: Trail viewpoint presents both waterfall tiers within the green cliff landscape. Useful classic-view alternative; resolution unverified.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Expedition photograph shows both Gocta falls from the approach. Strong location provenance and useful cliff context; resolution unverified.

images.author: Omri D. Cohen
images.why: Location-tagged Gocta photograph with a broader mountain-and-valley composition. Freely licensed alternative; waterfall prominence and portrait crop need checking.

images.author: Heather Jasper
images.why: Close viewpoint emphasizes the immense lower plunge and spray. Lower-priority fallback because it does not provide the preferred complete two-tier view.

images.why: Portrait-oriented travel photograph emphasizes Gocta's long plunge amid greenery. Available file is only 640×960, below the preferred resolution.

images.why: Third documented view of Kjelfossen, offering another composition for a waterfall-centered crop. Native resolution unverified.

images.author: Arne Moslåtten
images.why: Named photographer's location-specific Kjelfossen composition. Page states that the photograph is copyrighted by its author; supplied rendition is 1400 pixels high.

images.author: Johnny Cheng
images.why: Documented Gudvangen visit provides a recognizable valley-floor view. Upper portions can be obscured from this viewpoint, so it is not a complete top-to-bottom depiction.

images.author: wghartenstein
images.why: Photographer's dedicated Kjelfossen gallery provides a distinct Gudvangen view. This is a gallery-sized derivative; a larger original would be preferable.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Gudvangen destination gallery explicitly identifies the pictured waterfall as Kjelfossen. Additional composition candidate; dimensions and portrait-crop suitability remain unverified.

images.why: Strongest identification: specialist source places these braided cascades below Isella Glacier on Bonanza's south face. Search shortfall: only three distinct, confidently identified candidates were located; this does not establish that fewer than six exist.

images.author: Kyle McCrohan
images.why: Portrait photograph captioned as a wall of waterfalls beneath Bonanza, in the Isella Glacier section of the trip report. Promising vertical composition, but this file is only 683×1024.

images.author: Kyle McCrohan
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies waterfalls descending from Isella Glacier, with autumn poplars adding colour. Wider landscape composition; supplied file is only 1024×683.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Dedicated Johannesburg Falls record identifies the long cascade seen from Cascade River Road. Resolution unverified.
